::: callout-tip
## JWKS to PEM conversion

This workshop uses <https://bulk-data.smarthealthit.org> to provide a testing FHIR server, which will generate a public/private keypair in JWKS format. To use this keypair in Python, it must be converted to PEM format for use in Python, which can be done using [this web page](pem.html).
:::
